title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Priya Nair
description:
Context: We want to make it faster for engineers to adopt Redwood's Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and agent/tool-calling patterns by shipping curated templates, runnable examples, and step-by-step quickstarts on the docs site. This PR adds a small set of vetted RAG agent templates (tracker, FAQ bot, and summarizer), two tool-calling quickstarts (calendar and ticketing connectors), and corresponding docs pages with copy, runnable snippets, and screenshots.

Motivation: customers consistently ask for concrete end-to-end examples that show (1) template prompt wiring, (2) KV/prefix caching considerations, and (3) how to safely wire external tools (KMS and scoped credentials).

What I changed:
- redwood-examples/rag-templates/{faq-bot,meeting-summarizer,tracker}: added templates, README, example prompt files, and minimal unit tests that validate template rendering.
- redwood-examples/agents/tool-calling/{calendar,ticketing}: added quickstart apps with Dockerfile and run instructions; each includes a mock tool server for local testing.
- redwood-docs/content/quickstarts/rag-agent-templates.md: full quickstart with step-by-step CLI and SDK snippets, screenshots, and troubleshooting notes.
- redwood-docs/content/quickstarts/tool-calling.md: shows patterns for tool schemas, validation, and recommended retry/fallback policies.
- docs images and screenshots under docs/static/img/quickstarts/; added a small animated GIF for the ticketing flow.
- tests/e2e/quickstarts/test_rag_agent_quickstart.py: smoke test that spins up the mock tool and verifies end-to-end flow against local examples.
- updated sidebar and TOC entries so the new pages surface under Quickstarts > Agents & RAG.

Checklist:
- [x] Add templates + READMEs
- [x] Add runnable examples and Dockerfiles
- [x] Update docs site pages and TOC
- [x] Add smoke e2e test and unit tests
- [x] Run full docs build and lint
- [x] Sign-off from docs and examples reviewers

Compatibility notes: Templates target the current stable public API and include examples for both SDK and REST; no breaking API changes. We added guidance for using customer KMS but did not change any runtime behavior.

Testing & CI:
- Local unit tests for template rendering added (+4 tests)
- Smoke e2e test added (runs in our e2e job)
- Docs build and linkcheck run in CI

Notes for reviewers: pay attention to the docs wording around KMS usage (we intentionally recommend a scoped service account) and the ticketing connector's credential rotation instructions.

Deployment plan: Docs pages go live on merge; examples are consumed via the redwood-examples repo (the runner image is small and will be published separately after a release).
commits: init: add RAG templates and README; feat: add calendar tool-calling quickstart and mock tool; feat: add ticketing quickstart and GIF; docs: add quickstart pages and sidebar updates; test: add e2e smoke test for quickstarts; fix: minor linting and docs link fixes
review_comments: Avery Chen: Nice set of examples — can we add a short section that explains when to prefer prefix caching vs full context caching? Also please surface a note about privacy-sensitive data and recommended redaction patterns.
Priya Nair (author): Added a short section in rag-agent-templates.md about caching tradeoffs and an FAQ entry on redaction. Also added a link to the privacy guidelines (docs/security/privacy.md).

Marco Ruiz: The ticketing quickstart references KMS usage but the example shows plaintext env vars. Please update the example to show a KMS-wrapped secret or a note with SDK snippet for decrypting a secret via customer KMS.

Priya Nair (author): Updated ticketing README and docs to show an example using Redwood's env-kms helper and added a code snippet that demonstrates decrypting a token with KMS. Kept the local plaintext env for dev but made intent explicit.
Leah Thompson: e2e smoke test flakes occasionally in CI (timeout). Recommend increasing startup timeout and adding a retry on service health-check in the test harness.
Priya Nair (author): Increased test startup timeout from 10s to 30s and added a small retry/backoff. Re-ran e2e job — now stable.
release_notes: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts: three templates (FAQ, summarizer, tracker), two tool-calling quickstarts (calendar, ticketing), docs pages and smoke tests. No breaking changes.
notes: Follow-up work: publish example runner images to the examples registry (ENG-1150) and add additional templates for multi-tool orchestration. Also consider a short video walkthrough for the ticketing quickstart.
